about_the_game:
Ronza is a psychological horror game where you play as a timid little girl haunted by fear, paranoia, and an overactive imagination. Terrified of her strict teacher and unable to face another day at school, she secretly skips class—without her mother knowing—and takes refuge in an old, abandoned hospital on the edge of town.

The hospital, known as Ronza, was shut down years ago after a series of disturbing incidents that were never fully explained. She doesn’t know the full history… but she feels it.

Hiding there, waiting for the school day to pass, she discovers a forgotten admin room with a still-functioning computer full of games—the kind she loves. For a moment, things feel okay… until the hallucinations begin.

As she plays, faint voices echo through the halls. Distant footsteps. Crying. The mortuary is just a few doors away!

But is any of it real… or just the product of a frightened child's mind unraveling?

Ronza is a deeply unsettling exploration of childhood fear, trauma, and imagination—where reality blurs, and safety is only ever temporary.

Controls:
E to interact.

This game was made by a solo dev, I'll try my best to keep developing the rest of the nights of this game, currently the game has 3 nights, every night shows the story of every single character in the game from night 1, every character can attack you during the night and everyone has his own counter method and their attacking sign either by a weird sound or mimicking your voice or even opening the door suddenly

This game was inspired by welcome to the game, exit 8 and fnaf, the UI of the operating system was inspired by windows xp to simulate the childhood story of the main character.

feedbacks are appreciated and I hope you have a great experience!

content_descriptors.notes: this game contains blood and a bit of violence/killing but it doesn't contain drugs or nudity or sexual acts at all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5850 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: notes

short_description: Ronza is a tense survival game where you sit at a PC, uncover dark secrets, play games and listen for dangers creeping near. Strange characters stalk you, each with their own way to counter. Stay alert, react fast, and survive the night while the computer pulls you deeper.
